notes: Chief Telecom LY2 is located at No. 250 Yangguang Street, Neihu District, Taipei City; it became operational in June 2024 and is described as the only high-specification AI internet data center (IDC) in Taiwan until at least 2026 (Taiwan Business TOPICS). twreporter notes Chief Telecom is building two 20 MW facilities, one in Neihu (Taipei) and one at Central Taiwan Science Park; LY2 is the Neihu facility.
